flags.note: muṣṭalaḥ (technical term) and mafhūm (concept) are used against each other in all three titles, and the genitive constructions are ambiguous without the episodes. The programme is named Mafāhīm ('Concepts'), and these three appear to be its opening theoretical episodes. The numbering also runs out of order in the source (2, 3, 1). A reviewer with access to the episodes should fix these renderings.

flags.context: The whole record: the page is a list of episode titles, not a text.
options: Render as an index of audio episodes, not as an article
flags.note: This record has no prose in it at all: it is a navigation index of 33 episode titles of the Sheikh's television programme, whose content exists only as audio and video. It passes the 200-character test but is not a written text by the Sheikh. It must not be rendered as an article, and the English titles must not be presented as though they were summaries of teaching.

translator_notes: The CMS does not expose a category or section for this record on the article view, and the 2010 archive is not reachable through the site's section listings. section/category_ar/category_en are therefore left null rather than inferred.

The order of the list is the source's own, which runs mostly in descending episode number; it has been kept exactly, including the two spellings of al-iltizām in items 22-25 and the missing spaces before some numerals in the Arabic.
Mafāhīm, the programme title, is left transliterated. It means 'Concepts'.
No content of any episode is present in this record, and none has been supplied.
